data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 17.538 million in 2018, calculated from the claims development triangle. This contrasts with the reported net favourable prior year development of GBP 42.8 million, which was attributed to a benign claims environment, favourable attritional losses, and notable development in Political Risks & Political Violence.
raw_causal_phrases: benign year and an element of favourable prior year development, notably on Political Risks & Political Violence

decrease in the net loss ratio to 51.8% (2017: 67.2%) reflects a benign period of catastrophe events (compared to 2017 hurricane impact), with an element of favourable prior year development on attritional losses.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is calculated gross from the claims development triangle, showing a strengthening of GBP 17.538m. This contrasts with the narrative statement on page 15 which reports a net favourable prior year development of GBP 42.8m. The causes mentioned in the narrative (benign year, favourable attritional losses, Political Risks & Political Violence) are associated with the net release, not the gross strengthening. No gross LOB breakdown for prior year development was available.
